amex.name: American Express Platinum Card
amex.offer: Amex shows you your own welcome offer before you apply. The referral page says "as high as 175,000" Membership Rewards points; yours may be lower. From the same page you can choose a different Amex card.
amex.we_get: If you are approved, the person who runs this site earns Membership Rewards points from Amex.

chase.name: Chase Sapphire cards
chase.offer: When checked on November 20, 2026, the referral page showed 75,000 bonus points on Sapphire Preferred after $5,000 of purchases in the first 3 months. Offers change, so read the page.
chase.we_get: If you are approved, the person who runs this site earns Chase points.

rakuten.name: Rakuten
rakuten.offer: When checked on November 24, 2026, Rakuten's referral offer was a $50 bonus after you join and spend $50 on qualifying purchases within 90 days.
rakuten.we_get: If you qualify, the person who runs this site also gets a $50 bonus from Rakuten.
rakuten.top: New to Rakuten? When checked on November 24, 2026, Rakuten's own store pages offered new members a $10 welcome bonus. This referral link showed $50 after $50 of qualifying purchases within 90 days.

topcashback.name: TopCashback
topcashback.offer: TopCashback is free to join. When checked on November 24, 2026, its refer-a-friend page stated no joining bonus for the new member through this link. Offers change, so read the page.
topcashback.we_get: This is our refer-a-friend link. If you join through it and earn $10 in cash back within 180 days, the person who runs this site gets a bonus from TopCashback.
